status: Complete declarative scientific/API repair for EEG-D1; not runtime enforcement or scientific qualification.
chosen_design: One campaign-frozen meta-algorithm with separately initialized, strictly outer-fold-local adaptive development. Both fixed handwritten learners and a frozen code-generating agent are allowed as meta-algorithms. No post-exposure global method revision.
precedence: This contract and current DESIGN/API/OPERATORS/METRICS/REFERENCES are the operative S2 version. Original v1 bodies remain exact history. No authority is inferred from an old source/operator binding to bypass this cross-cutting boundary.

estimand.procedure: For dataset d, outer fold f and downstream repetition r, a fixed M_a (access arm a) maps permitted pre-exposure resources plus (train_df, validation_df), frozen seeds and finite budgets to generated source/configuration and fitted state. Its prediction on query_df is evaluated only after irreversible closure. M_a includes all adaptive proposal generation and selection, not just the final weights. The outcome is the declared equal-fold then equal-repetition performance of this procedure on the fixed cohort/support.
estimand.learning: Fold-local selection, debugging, generated code, early stopping and normalization fitting are real learning operations inside M_a. They may differ across folds. One frozen method means one frozen M_a, not byte-identical learned parameters or generated code across folds. For P each generated implementation must still satisfy its common scientific method-family definition; I remains arbitrary within policy.
estimand.independence: Shared raw training subjects across outer folds are normal. They do not license transfer of a label-dependent decision/state between folds. Validation or training in j can contain the person held out in i; no resulting information is eligible in i.
estimand.inference_limit: Reported contrasts/intervals condition on the fixed cohort, fitted folds and selected seeds/checkpoints. This design does not establish independent fold observations, unconditional population generalization, full meta-learning uncertainty or a causal effect. Public or pretrained-model exposure remains unresolved.

genesis.when: Before any participant, source-generating agent, adaptive operator or trusted reference developer sees any campaign downstream training/development/assessment payload, fold-derived feedback or H replay outcomes. Assessment queries are also unavailable for method construction.
frozen_fields: common scientific specification and policy IDs
all family/slot/dataset/fold/run manifests and prospective split algorithm
M_A/M_B source or generator executable and dependency closure
agent base-model identity, weights/revision, initial prompt and context bytes
tool definitions, routing, parser and allowed scientific external knowledge snapshot
all inherited resource digests and exposure/rights declarations
source-generation, debugging and validation feedback policy
candidate and reference search spaces, stopping, tie and optional refit rules
reference selector S_df and complete four-control order
seed derivation, all per-run streams and agent sampling policy
failure, retry, abort and scheduler policy
genesis.initial_information: Paper/common neutral task/API/provider documentation and independently admitted static knowledge/resources; B additionally gets exact author source. No campaign label-dependent result, fold transcript, H replay output, generated method or controller memory enters either genesis. Corpus-only pretraining after G0 uses fixed recipes and its own eligible sealed context.
genesis.arbitrary_package: An ordinary submitted learner or a source-generating agent is permitted. The latter is declared before G0 and can emit code only inside its fold episode with recorded inputs and outputs. A human may supply an arbitrary initial implementation before G0; later human/remote-agent method advice based on campaign outputs is forbidden.
genesis.external_agent: An LLM service requires a pinned model/version and qualified stateless request/session policy, no conversation/cache/retrieval/fine-tuning updates across folds, original request/completion/resource provenance and no hidden access to other fold outputs. If these cannot be qualified, that agent route is unavailable under G16/G17/G20. Resetting a visible chat is not evidence of backend isolation.
genesis.changes: Any data-driven change to G0 source/prompt/tools/method/control rule aborts protected qualification of the current campaign; original results remain exploratory. A new policy on the same exposed cohort cannot be described as newly blind. Fresh authorization/qualification and exposure accounting are required, not an automatic reset.
genesis.chronological_binding: G0 pins existing resources and future producer/episode specifications, never a future result hash. Later issuer receipts bind the G0 digest, original completed parent receipts and exact produced artifacts in chronological order. No cyclic G0/result identity or fabricated future receipt is allowed.

local: repetition_id or declared three-run development-selector scope
identities.episode: E=(campaign,mode,access,policy,actor_role,dataset,outer_fold). Candidate and each trusted reference control use distinct E. Three downstream repeats retain independently seeded fit/inference workers; the frozen within-fold selector may read all three validation summaries. The participant meta-algorithm may deliberately share its fold-local development history across repetitions only if G0 declares it, in which case report that dependence and do not claim independent adaptive-search repeats.
identities.mandatory_joins: Every A01–A13 request, generated-source record, context seal, fitted state, reference bank, selection receipt, output and issuer completion binds the full relevant identity. O01/O04/O05/O09/O11/O15/O16/O17/O30/O31 verify original ancestry and reject missing, substituted, stale or cross-fold roots; participant assertions alone cannot establish it.

information_sets.G0_common: Immutable pre-exposure resources only. Read-only aliases allowed if every descendant episode is independently eligible; no fitted/selected state derived from downstream fold labels.
information_sets.PRETRAIN_common: Fixed corpus-only recipe/seed, approved five-source train/pretrain-validation and original completed producer. May feed multiple folds only if overlap/exposure audit proves eligibility for every descendant and no downstream feedback selected its source/config/checkpoint. Otherwise independent fold-local restricted-corpus lineage; costs increase explicitly.
information_sets.E_development: G0 + eligible pretraining/inherited roots + exact outer-fold train/validation capabilities + own source-generation/training/development feedback and logs. Other folds, datasets, modes and access arms supply no adaptive products. No assessment queries until development closes.
information_sets.E_query: Closed local development/source/config/transform choices + sealed state + exact allowed target-free query. All predictions/diagnostics follow fixed policy; separately named transductive A07 permits only current case unlabeled support and never feeds development or another fold.
information_sets.REF_development: Same eligible outer-fold train/development information but private reference workers. Frozen method recipes/search policies; candidate artifacts, scores and advice absent. Reference selector sees four completed controls and three run validation summaries from this same (d,f) only.
information_sets.scheduler: Frozen logical DAG, resource admission and redacted lifecycle/completion/failure facts. No mutable source-generating controller reads fold payload/log/metric content. Safety/resource status may trigger only G0 retry/abort choices; cannot tune methods, budgets or selection. Operator administration privileges are not scientific permission to adapt.
information_sets.scorer: Only after every active H/P/I and A/B prediction branch/worker/child and selector is closed, trusted private target join and reductions. No downstream communication back to development.
information_sets.report: After complete scoring, A13 gets identical approved aggregate release in fresh report-only contexts; it cannot reopen the campaign or inform a still-running fold.

raw_preparation.static: Shared byte copying, authenticated event indexing, channel/unit mappings and fixed per-epoch transforms may be computed centrally only as fixed nonadaptive operators; no aggregate learned statistics or outcome-dependent exclusions.
raw_preparation.learned: Filtering/normalization/artifact thresholds/feature selection/label mapping choices learned from signal or labels are fitted using only E-eligible training/development support as specified, sealed and attributed to E. A derived cache inherits all raw support and fit-selection ancestry; hiding targets in a later view cannot erase that dependence.
raw_preparation.assessment: No outer query-derived preprocessing choices enter fit in strict inductive P/I; source EA/session adaptation is the named transductive route only. Same person/event aliases across corpora, sessions and all raw-derived caches must be checked before sharing.

source_and_cache_custody.fold_state: Agent conversation, memory, embeddings/retrieval index, generated code, compiled artifacts, diagnostic files, stdout/stderr, validation metrics, checkpoints, exception traces and scratch state are private to E; even an aggregate or a filename may encode label-dependent information.
source_and_cache_custody.mounts: Fresh process/filesystem/IPC/session and per-episode cache namespace; no shared writable home, package/build cache, conversation store or export directory. Read-only common artifacts require G0 or eligible PRETRAIN ancestry. Dependency caches can share exact content only when independent of campaign observations and pinned before G0.
source_and_cache_custody.closure: On completion retain immutable original inputs, prompts/tool requests, generated-source parents, full streams, errors, resource and completion receipts operator-private. They are not recycled into another episode. Final source/state seals are local outputs, not new globally trusted parents.
source_and_cache_custody.sharing: Content equality alone does not prove independent origin or eligibility. Cross-fold generated-source/config/state/cache reuse is forbidden even if a name/digest matches a known artifact, unless original ancestry proves it was the pre-exposure immutable parent (no dynamic alias laundering).
source_and_cache_custody.reference_reuse: A/B reference-bank alias requires identical G0/selector/info roots, same d,f,r and complete method/state/selection/completion ancestry. Different folds cannot share label-dependent fitted states or selection decisions; corpus-only eligible parents may be shared. H-exposed states never become protected parents.

chronology.operation: Freeze G0 before campaign payload or feedback exposure
Admit eligible corpus-only parent producers and seal original completion; or allocate independent fold-local parents
Instantiate E candidate/reference fresh context and actor-specific budgets; mint exact train/development capabilities
Run finite local generation/prepare/pretrain/fit/validate cycles with complete causal receipts
Close local adaptation; select final config/epoch/refit and strongest control using only same-fold development; seal source/contexts/states
Issue permitted queries and frozen diagnostics in isolated inference workers; collect exact logical slots and all failure statuses
Reap all active workers/children, close all branches and selectors, authenticate ancestry and original completion/resources
Private target join, all metrics/selected-rule/all-control contrasts and full coverage
Aggregate release to fresh report-only A13, independent reasoning adjudication; no backedge

failure_policy.denied_before_exposure: Deny mismatched E/ancestry requests and preserve attempted identity, original error/resource cost and all required slots. A denied attempt is not proof of actual leakage; whether a local retry remains permitted follows the frozen finite G0 rule.
failure_policy.actual_or_unknown_transfer: If cross-episode feedback/source/cache/label transfer occurred, or required original custody is missing so absence cannot be established, affected protected episode and every dependency-descendant is unqualified. If extent cannot be bounded, whole protected campaign is unqualified. Keep scientific outputs as exposed/exploratory with full denominators; never silently restart, drop a fold or score as success.
failure_policy.references: Missing/unqualified controls or selector input yields operator/reference unavailable. Do not choose among available controls, fill missing summaries with zero or redefine the strongest-control family. Candidate no-tools/abstention still requires all516 reference slots.
failure_policy.completion: Every source-generation, agent/tool request, validation reduction, selection and refit has original launch/input/output/exit/signal/timeout/forced-stop/reap/resource records. A plausible output after failed producer cannot be sealed; refusals and all consumed resources persist.

scope_and_gates.qualification: G07/G08/G12/G13/G16/G17/G19/G20/G24 require later actual audits; all24 gates remain open. This design cannot certify semantic absence of memorization from arbitrary code/model weights merely through isolation.
